note: The approved baseline for docs/template/ — scripts/check-templates.mjs compares the tree against this list and fails on any deviation. WHY A LIST AND NOT A HARD BLOCK: a checksum gate with no exit turns every legitimate change into a broken build, and a gate that is routinely wrong teaches people to bypass it. The exit is one line in docs/work/WORKLOG.md — template-authorised: <file> <sha256-of-approved-content> — a human-written record in the log of record, and the check accepts nothing less (see that script's header).
